_comment: pcf2caesar.py job for Revit/PipeEX PCF -> CAESAR II PCF with rule-placed supports. Every value is a PLACEHOLDER to replace from the project specification and drawings; paths are relative to this file. Keys starting with _ are ignored at the top level. The dicts pcf_files, models, lines, pcf_attributes and chiller_port_lines are iterated by the script and carry no _comment keys.
_comment_name: Output stem and log name. Default: job.
name: example_model_a
_comment_outdir: REQUIRED. Output folder (created): NAME_<line>.pcf, NAME_combined.pcf, NAME_supports.csv, NAME_report.json, NAME.log.
_comment_pcf_dir: Folder of the PCF files, relative to this file. Default: this file's folder.
_comment_pcf_files: REQUIRED. {tag: file name}, one Revit PCF per tag. Tags are used by models and lines below.
_comment_box_ft: Model box in feet, plant coordinates: [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax], or a dict that may add zmin and zmax. Records outside are dropped; records that cross the edge become cut ends. Absent: no box.
_comment_models: {model name: [tags]}. A connected piece goes to the model whose tags exclusively own most of its elements. Absent: one model of all tags.
_comment_model: Which model to build. Optional when models has one entry.
_comment_unassigned_by_bore: For a piece that no tag owns (all elements shared): at or below max_bore_in it goes to le, above it to gt. Absent: the first model.
_comment_lines: REQUIRED. {line: {files: [tags], pcf_attributes: {PCF attribute: value}}}. One output PCF per line. The attribute values are PLACEHOLDER strings: replace from the project basis.
_comment_small_bore_max: Records at or below this bore (in) are dropped. Default 2.0.
_comment_chiller_body_bore_in: UNDEFINED records whose first bore equals this (in) are equipment bodies: removed, their ports become equipment nozzles. Absent: none removed.
_comment_chiller_tag_prefix: Tag prefix of those bodies in the end report. Default EQ.
_comment_chiller_port_lines: Line each body port feeds: {port name (END1, BRANCH1-POINT): line}.
_comment_end_overrides: Classify an open end by position: xyz_ft, kind (EQUIP anchors, CUT anchors, FREE), tag, basis. Matches within 1 in.

end_overrides.basis: PLACEHOLDER: open end in the export, identity to be confirmed

_comment_equipment_ff_ft: Finished-floor elevations (ft). A nozzle's floor is the highest one at or below it; the base-support rule looks above it.
_comment_base_support: Base-support rule: walk at most base_walk_max_ft from an equipment nozzle to the first bend lower than base_bend_max_above_ff_ft above the floor; support it. A bend farther than near_support_max_ft also gets a support near_nozzle_in off the nozzle. All EXAMPLE distances.
_comment_base_bend_max_above_ff_ft: A bend counts as low when its highest end is no higher than this many ft above the nozzle floor, or 36 in above the nozzle if that is higher.
_comment_base_walk_max_ft: Longest walk from the nozzle to look for that bend, ft.
_comment_near_support_max_ft: A low bend farther than this from the nozzle also gets a near-nozzle support.
_comment_near_nozzle_in: Distance (in) from the nozzle of the support on the first straight pipe when there is no low bend.
_comment_riser: Risers: a support at each floor crossing (riser_clamp_above_floor_ft above the floor) and no vertical run longer than riser_max_ft without one. EXAMPLE values.
_comment_riser_floors_ft: Floor elevations (ft) a vertical run crosses; each gets a riser support.
_comment_riser_clamp_above_floor_ft: Height of that support above the floor, ft. Default 1.0.
_comment_riser_max_ft: Longest vertical run without a support, ft. Default 14.
_comment_span_table_ft: REQUIRED. [[largest NPS, span ft], ...] ascending NPS. PLACEHOLDER values: take the spans from the project support specification, never from this example.
_comment_merge_in: Supports closer than this (in) on one pipe are merged, keeping the higher priority one.
_comment_tee_rule: A branch of at most tee_carry_ratio x header size is carried by the header; a larger one gets a support near_tee_in from the tee.
_comment_tee_carry_ratio: A branch at most this fraction of the header size is carried by the header. Default 0.5.
_comment_near_tee_in: Distance (in) from the tee of the support on a larger branch. Default 18.
_comment_no_support_below_ft: Non-anchor supports below this elevation (ft) are dropped (buried pipe). Absent: keep all.
_comment_support_prefix: Support NAME prefix: NAME <prefix>-<TYPE>_<model><nnn>. Default PTS.
_comment_project_identifier: Written as PROJECT-IDENTIFIER in each PCF. Default: not written.
_comment_area: Written as AREA in each PCF. Default: not written.
